name: Crucible Code
tagline: The harness where agents are forged.

quickstart.label: Build from source (Linux x86-64, glibc 2.34 or newer)
quickstart.code:
git clone https://github.com/augments-labs/crucible-code
cd crucible-code
cargo build --release
./target/release/crucible --version

highlights: A terminal coding agent: it reads, searches, edits and runs things in the directory you start it in
Asks before anything that changes a file or starts a process
One dynamically linked binary. No runtime, no certificate bundle, nothing else to install
Provider keys are read from the environment and never stored

name: Augments ADK
tagline: A framework to orchestrate a complex system of agents that performs real-world actions.

quickstart.label: Install with uv, or with plain pip
quickstart.code: uv add augments-adk  # or: pip install augments-adk

highlights: Orchestrate complex systems of agents that perform real-world actions
Graphs, handoffs and swarms with checkpointing, streaming and cancellation
Guardrails, permissions and governance built into the runtime
Observability and tracing from the very first run

name: SDLC Skills
tagline: Rigorous, phase-isolated SDLC skills that tether autonomous agents to real-world engineering standards.
highlights: Phase-isolated skills that cover the whole SDLC, from planning through maintenance
Harness adapters for Claude Code, Codex and Kimi Code, each with session-start routing
Portable Markdown skills you can adopt in any harness that can invoke one
